description: Case do NHÓM tự viết thêm để cover thêm trường hợp. Mỗi case cần: id, phase='B', query HOẶC turns, failure_type (thuộc allowed_failure_types), và expect (tool_calls[...] hoặc no_tool=true). Nên kèm metadata.what_it_tests.

cases.query: Find 5 recent academic papers on Vision Transformers, preferably from peer-reviewed conferences or journals. Include their abstracts and citation counts.

metadata.what_it_tests: Academic literature discovery requiring abstracts and citation counts should route to Semantic Scholar rather than arXiv-only search.

cases.query: Find research papers specifically on arXiv about Retrieval-Augmented Generation evaluation.

metadata.what_it_tests: Explicit arXiv requirement should route to papers instead of semantic_scholar.

cases.query: Explain what a Vision Transformer is and how its self-attention mechanism works.

metadata.what_it_tests: A conceptual question answerable using existing model knowledge should not trigger unnecessary academic search.
